behavior: A toast with no title takes its accessible name from its description: `aria-labelledby` has the id of the description, and the toast has no `aria-describedby`. WAI-ARIA requires a name for the roles `dialog` and `alertdialog`. When the consumer gives the toast an `aria-label` or an `aria-labelledby` that is not blank, the toast takes the name of the consumer and keeps its description, as in Base UI. A blank `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, and an `aria-labelledby` of `undefined`, are not given, so the toast takes its name from its description. An `aria-labelledby` of `null` removes the name: the toast has no `aria-labelledby` and keeps its description. Base UI gives a toast with no title no name.
